concerns.text: The implementation plan states it will download the **MoleculeNet ESOL** dataset (`delaney-processed.csv`) and use the `logP` column as the target property. ESOL provides aqueous solubility (log S), not log P. Using this dataset for a logP prediction task is therefore inappropriate; the plan must switch to a verified dataset that actually contains logP values (e.g., MoleculeNet Lipophilicity) and update all downstream schema references accordingly.
